notes: International car configuration retains the complete northern course, northeastern extension, central hairpin and southern main straight. Exact 2018 public coordinates give 4,081.6 m; the operator identifies a 4,085 m car circuit. Western junction chicanes, pit-lane way 48683141, club closing alternatives and the separate training center are excluded. The 2020 licensed regional orthophoto confirms the paved course. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

Produced using Copernicus data and information funded by the European Union, EU-DEM layers.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.
